headlines.title_zh: Meta在英推出AI代理Muse并针对性修改服务条款
headlines.title_en: The CMA says Meta made changes to Muse's ToS in the UK to reflect the country's consumer law; the terms give users far more protections than in the US (Joseph Bambridge/Politico)
headlines.author: Politico
headlines.event_summary_zh: Meta在英国上线AI代理Muse，并因应当地消费者法修改了责任条款，较美国市场承担更高的法律风险与合规义务
headlines.event_summary_en: Meta launched its AI agent Muse in the UK with revised terms of service, significantly reducing liability waivers compared to the US version to comply with local consumer protection laws. This strategic move highlights the growing regulatory friction as Big Tech companies adapt global AI deployment to heterogeneous legal frameworks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Meta（跨国科技巨头），英国竞争与市场管理局（CMA）在英国市场：修改AI代理Muse服务条款，剔除部分损害赔偿免责限制，承诺在专业尽职范围内承担责任
【起因与机理】满足英国更严格的消费者法律准入要求，并应对监管机构对AI代理自主交易风险的担忧
【核心事实细节】Meta为进入英国市场接受了更严格的法律责任条款。
【各方立场与态度】英国竞争与市场管理局（CMA）及金融行为监管局（FCA）将Muse视为行业监管风向标。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Meta, UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) (United Kingdom): Revised ToS for Muse, removing broad liability shields and accepting professional diligence standards
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To meet stringent UK consumer law requirements and address regulatory scrutiny over autonomous agent risks
[Market & Financial Detail] Meta accepted stricter legal liability to access the UK market.
[Key Position & Outlook] The CMA and FCA are positioning Muse as a regulatory litmus test for future AI deployments.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此案例标志着全球AI代理商业化进入“属地合规时代”，头部厂商此前通过格式合同规避模型幻觉风险的策略正受到区域性法律挑战。随着金融与消费场景的渗透，AI代理的法律人格与赔偿边界将成为决定其能否规模化落地的核心技术及成本变量。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This case signals the beginning of the 'territorial compliance era' for AI agents, where standard liability-shielding contracts are increasingly challenged by regional consumer laws. As agents penetrate financial and commercial sectors, legal accountability will become a critical variable influencing the scalability and operational cost of foundation models.

headlines.title_zh: SAP拟裁员万人以加速AI转型
headlines.title_en: SAP plans to cut at least 10,000 jobs as it pivots to AI
headlines.author: Maximilian Schreiner
headlines.event_summary_zh: SAP计划裁员至少1万人以优化AI业务架构，重组重点覆盖研发与销售部门
headlines.event_summary_en: SAP is initiating a major restructuring to cut at least 10,000 jobs, representing roughly 9% of its global workforce. Led by CEO Christian Klein, the initiative aims to streamline product development and sales divisions to pivot resources toward embedding AI across its enterprise software portfolio.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】SAP CEO Christian Klein及公司人力资源部门在SAP全球各分部，特别是产品开发与销售部门：拟裁减至少1万名员工，重塑组织架构以优先保障AI战略部署
【起因与机理】应对软件产业智能化转型压力，削减运营成本以强化AI产品线竞争力
【关键数据与实测】SAP拟在全球裁员超1万人以优化成本结构。
【各方立场与态度】公司正通过收购与合作全面提速AI业务转型路径。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] CEO Christian Klein and SAP HR department: Proposing 10,000+ layoffs to reallocate capital toward AI integration
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To navigate the industry-wide transition to AI-driven enterprise solutions
[Key Metrics] SAP is initiating a major restructuring to cut at least 10,000 jobs, representing roughly 9% of its global workforce.
[Key Position & Outlook] The company is accelerating its AI pivot via strategic acquisitions and partnerships.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: SAP此举揭示了传统SaaS巨头在AI转型期严酷的财务效率平衡术：通过人力资源结构性降本弥补AI研发的高昂边际成本。该行为显示行业已从单纯的AI技术试点进入到业务架构重构的实质阶段，即以牺牲传统人力资本为代价，换取AI模型嵌入式的产品议价权。
headlines.industry_impact_en: SAP's move reflects the harsh trade-offs of the AI transition, where legacy SaaS giants must aggressively cut labor costs to subsidize high AI R&D expenditures. This signals a shift from AI piloting to structural business model overhaul, aiming to secure pricing power through deep AI integration.

celebrity.author: Sam Altman
celebrity.quote_zh:
文是最早相信我们可以使用当时的模型来解决千禧年奖金问题的人之一。

世界上有很多才华横溢的人，但才华横溢，并且拥有正确的信心和勇气，继续推动别人认为不可能的事情，是一件非常有价值的事情，而且相当罕见。

我很感激 OpenAI 的很多人都拥有这种组合。
celebrity.quote_en:
Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.

There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare.

I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.
